name: The Border Customs House
act: Act I: The Forfeit Corridor & Foyer
description: Act I staging ground: The administrative checkpoint wedged between two level chunks. Pell and Surveyor Vellum must clear or smuggle Crate #00-NULL past Quartermaster Hollis's weigh beam and ledger desk.

cast.name: Hollis the Twice-Written
cast.description: Arbitrates the two-column ledger. Refuses transit to unweighed or unauthored cargo unless a provisional seal or warrant is struck.

cast.name: Pell the Underwritten
cast.description: Travels with a prompt book blank below the first line; must earn or improvise standing to cross the proscenium threshold.

cast.name: Factor Vane
cast.description: Nervous broker offering 300 sovereigns of unmarked silver to slip Crate #00-NULL through the Forfeit Wicket unweighed.

primitives.name: Crate #00-NULL (R6-SHIP Bounding Crate)
primitives.stage_role: Primary Consignment Cargo (42.5 kg declared / 280 kg actual)
primitives.description: Man-portable Baltic pine shipping container with recessed hemp grab handles, black iron corner caps, and official red wax clearance seals.

primitives.name: Hexagonal Borosilicate Stasis Coffin
primitives.description: Elongated hexagonal borosilicate crystal sarcophagus leaking cryogenic vapor, smuggled across the border in Crate #00-NULL.

primitives.name: 1588 Beam Weigh Scale Station
primitives.stage_role: Act I Beat 1: Physical Weigh Gate (tips at >30 kg)
primitives.description: Zinc-topped inspection counter with counterbalanced brass beam scale and calibrated counterweights.

primitives.name: Hollis's Quartermaster Ledger Desk
primitives.stage_role: Act I Beat 2: Two-Column Ledger Inscription & Seal Strike
primitives.description: Heavy oak administrative desk holding the open two-column ledger and copper inkstand.

primitives.name: Customs Manifest Archive Shelf
primitives.stage_role: Precedent Lookup: Stores prior transit rolls & tariff statutes
primitives.description: Tall oak bookcase lined with clearance folios, tax statutes, and sealed transit rolls.

primitives.name: Sealed Stamp & Seal Cabinet
primitives.stage_role: Stores vermilion clearance wax sticks and brass transit dies
primitives.description: Iron-bound security cabinet storing vermilion seal sticks, brass dies, and impound tags.

primitives.name: Forfeit Storage Wardrobe
primitives.stage_role: Forfeit Corridor Impound Locker (blocks or stores seized goods)
primitives.description: Heavy locked cupboard lining the Forfeit Corridor where contested parcels await final destruction or auction.

primitives.name: Quartermaster Clerk Chair
primitives.stage_role: Elevated Dais Seat behind Hollis's Ledger Desk
primitives.description: High-backed carved wooden chair behind the quartermaster's elevated counter.

primitives.name: Intake Supplicant Bench
primitives.stage_role: Foyer Waiting Queue for Unwritten Carriers
primitives.description: Scarred timber bench where arriving carriers sit during clearance calculation.
